versions.content: AUTOSAR communication shall support the adaptable speed offered by CAN FD Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR communication shall support the CAN communication bus with all CAN-FD extensions Rationale: CAN-FD extends the communication capability in a backward compatible way. This comprises higher bandwidth and extended size of CAN frame data load Use Case: Especially for huge data transmissions e.g. device programming or diagnosis the extended payload and the increased payload baud rate improves communication speed Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
